answer: A newcomer locks 70 credits in a vault and needs 7 neighbor endorsements. Each neighbor stakes 15 credits and forges a receipt onto the nebula board, where endorsements stay visible. No neighbor may endorse more than two newcomers per epoch. A rented-neighbor ring is exposed on the board, and fakes burn the vault bond plus all 7 stakes. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 7,000 endorsements, locking 175,000; an honest newcomer pays 70 once and keeps it.
